fmas: Ia, Ib, IIa, IIb, II Babitonga, III
instruments: National list: Critically Endangered (Portaria MMA 444/2014; 148/2022). PAN Toninha, 1st cycle (Portaria ICMBio 91/2010) and 2nd cycle (Portaria ICMBio 655/2019). Fisheries regulations in areas of high bycatch (Secchi et al. 2021).
Priority species for conservation (Soutullo et al. 2013); National System of Protected Areas, e.g. Cabo Polonio National Park (Nin et al. 2010).
National Action Plan to reduce interactions of marine mammals with fisheries (named in the IWC CMP); species in the national list of species in need of protection (CMS COP15 Doc.31.2.8).
